units.source_text: 从半掩的窗户透进来的光线，洒落在他的衣服下摆上。

en.t: The light coming through the half-closed window fell over the hem of his clothes.

units.source_text: 在天花板的灯光照耀下，我从他脚跟前看去，他头部稍低，额头有阴影。

en.t: In the light from the ceiling, as I looked up from near his feet, his head was slightly lowered and his forehead was in shadow.

units.source_text: 光线照射到下巴颏、脸颊，乃至下陷的眼睑和眉头，落在鼻头上。

en.t: The light struck his chin and cheeks, reached even his sunken eyelids and brow, and fell on the tip of his nose.

units.source_text: 再仔细端详，下唇也有阴影，上唇却承受着亮光，

en.t: Looking more closely, I saw that the lower lip too was shadowed, while the upper lip caught the bright light,

units.source_text: 上下唇之间的嘴里也有浓重的阴影，只有一颗上齿是光闪闪的。

en.t: and inside the mouth between the upper and lower lips there was a deep shadow, with only one upper tooth gleaming.

units.source_text: 原来短短的唇髭里夹杂着白色的毛。

en.t: There were white hairs mixed into his short mustache.

units.source_text: 照片上，正面的右脸颊长有两颗大黑痣，它们也投下了阴影。

en.t: In the photograph, two large black moles on the right cheek as seen from the front also cast shadows.

units.source_text: 从鬓角到额上暴出的血管投下的阴影，也都拍摄出来了。

en.t: Even the shadows cast by the veins bulging from his temples up across his forehead had been captured.

units.source_text: 阴暗的额上也显出了横皱纹。

en.t: Horizontal wrinkles also showed on the darkened forehead.

units.source_text: 留短平头的发上有一处照到亮光。

en.t: One spot on his close-cropped hair was touched by bright light.

units.source_text: 名人的头发是很粗硬的。

en.t: The master's hair was very thick and stiff.
